name: New Rust compiler for faster compile times

mentions.name: New Rust compiler for faster compile times
mentions.description: This project builds a brand-new Rust compiler from scratch to radically improve Rust compile times, extending the approach used to create agent-built C++ compilers. It has not yet reached the Rust self-hosting stage, but early results are promising.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm taking a radical approach to improving rust compile times. The reason it is radical is it involves building a brand new rust compiler.
